automationNotes: Doc URL: https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/create-segmented-experience — **Prereq:** at least one **Audience** in the project (run `create-audience` first or use an existing audience). **Audience pick:** `PERSONALIZE_SEGMENTED_EXPERIENCE_AUDIENCE_CONTAINS` (else `PERSONALIZE_EDIT_AUDIENCE_ROW_CONTAINS`, else substring **AUTO Audience**). **Project card:** `PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS` / `DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`. Final doc step **Activate Draft** → **Activate** runs the live-activation path (doc also recommends CMS **Entry Variants** before go-live). DOM refs: `data/dom/Personalize/experiences.html`, `select-experience-type.html`, `segmented-experience-page.html`, `seg-exp-configuration.html`.
